_comment: File-write LOCKS that are not per-role (lifted out of role-capabilities.json when the role capability table moved onto the personas, epic `the-persona-is-the-whole-agent`). `dbOwnedPlanFiles` are plan artifacts the DB owns and no session may hand-edit; `depManifestFiles` are the shared dependency contract only a designated role may touch. Both are consumed by `roleDeniedCommands` in shared/lib/session/launchRules.
